home.heroTitle: Cross-chain security across the software lifecycle
home.heroBody: Three independent modules illustrate the three thesis studies: privacy-preserving design, pre-deployment contract auditing and post-deployment monitoring on two simulated EVM chains.
home.sdlcBody: Each study is a self-contained module with its own page; there is no end-to-end pipeline coupling them.

chain.title: Real Solidity contracts
chain.body: Two in-memory EVM chains (py-evm): chain-A (id 31337) and chain-B (id 97). Every transaction is mined into its own block for easy observation.

ml.title: Symbolic, fast algorithms
ml.body: Toy ZKP/TSS/CP-ABE, numpy/scikit-learn ML on small synthetic data with fixed seeds — every action runs under 3 seconds.

modes.title: Live or Replay
modes.body: Run locally with the FastAPI backend (live), or view on GitHub Pages from recorded scenarios (replay) — the UI is identical.

cd1.name: Π_univ
cd1.summary: Cross-chain academic credentials: the source chain anchors a Merkle commitment, the holder proves a business predicate in zero knowledge, a relay committee co-signs t-of-n and the destination chain verifies with ecrecover.

cd2.name: CrossGuard
cd2.topic: Vulnerability detection and auditing of cross-chain smart contracts
cd2.summary: Pre-deployment audit of bridge contracts: multi-source representation, few-shot classification, differentially private federated training and an audit report with protocol invariants.

cd3.name: CrossSentry
cd3.topic: Anomaly detection and adaptive trust assessment in cross-chain communication
cd3.summary: Monitoring a live bridge: two-chain event matching with evidence competence, Dempster–Shafer fusion, actor–corridor risk scores and R0–R5 responses with human approval.
